items.stem: The soup ______ delicious, so everyone in my family wants more.
items.rule: taste 作系动词后接形容词表「尝起来」，用主动一般现在时。
items.trap: 见食物「被尝」就选 is tasted；系动词无被动，也不用进行时。

items.stem: After cleaning the whole house alone, my mother looked ______ and went to bed early.
items.rule: look 是系动词接形容词；-ed 形容词表人「感到」，-ing 表事物「令人」。
items.trap: 主语是人却选 tiring；问谁感到累，人用 tired。

items.stem: The sweater your grandma made ______ very soft, and I wear it almost every day.
items.rule: feel 表「摸起来」是系动词，接形容词，用主动形式，不用被动或进行时。
items.trap: 选 is felt 或加 -ly 的 feels softly 都错：系动词后只放形容词。

items.stem: The old machine in the science museum ______ be broken, but it still works well.
items.rule: seem 后接不定式：seem to be / seem to do，不能直接接动词原形。
items.trap: 漏写 to 成 seems be；seem 无被动、不用进行时。

items.stem: The story about the two geniuses sounds ______, and all the students want to hear it again.
items.rule: -ing 形容词表「令人……的」，修饰引起感受的事物；sound 接形容词。
items.trap: 按「学生感兴趣」选 interested；陈述对象是 story，用 interesting。

items.stem: Nancy plays the piano very ______, and she dreams of becoming a musician.
items.rule: 修饰动词 play 要用副词 well；good 是形容词，只能作定语或表语。
items.trap: 按汉语「弹得好」写 very good；空修饰动词，必须用副词。

items.stem: The two young inventors worked so ______ on the machine that they forgot their dinner.
items.rule: hard 既是形容词也是副词；hardly 意为「几乎不」，不是 hard 的副词。
items.trap: 见 -ly 就当副词选 hardly，句意变「几乎不工作」，逻辑反了。

items.stem: The new model of the lunar eclipse is as ______ as the old one, and it is easier to carry.
items.rule: as + 形容词原级 + as 表同级比较，中间不能用比较级或最高级。
items.trap: 见比较就加 more；两个 as 之间只放原级，beautifully 也不能用。

items.stem: After a good sleep, my grandpa felt ______ better than the day before.
items.rule: 修饰比较级用 much/even/a lot/far；very 和 so 不能修饰比较级。
items.trap: 按汉语「好多了」写 very better；记 much/even/a lot + 比较级。

items.stem: Archimedes was no less ______ than the greatest scientists of his time.
items.rule: no less + 形容词原级 + than 表「不比……差」，其中用原级不用比较级。
items.trap: 照字面「更」就选 cleverer；no less…than 中间只能是原级。

items.stem: The lunar eclipse is one of the most ______ natural sights in the night sky.
items.rule: one of the + 最高级 + 可数名词复数：one of the most amazing sights。
items.trap: 别选 more amazing（most 已是最高级标记）；one of 后要接名词复数。

items.stem: It took Archimedes less than ______ hour to solve the king's problem.
items.rule: a/an 由首音素决定：hour 的 h 不发音，以元音音素开头用 an。
items.trap: 看字母 h 就选 a；先读出声，首音是元音才用 an。

items.stem: Her model was ______ first one that could show a lunar eclipse clearly.
items.rule: 序数词 first 前用定冠词 the；最高级、独一无二的事物前也用 the。
items.trap: first 前误用 a 或省掉 the；序数词前一律用 the。

items.stem: My brother goes to ______ school by bike every morning, even in winter.
items.rule: go to school 表「上学」，school 前用零冠词；go to bed 同理。
items.trap: 按汉语「去学校」加 the；表用途的名词前不加冠词。

items.stem: Wang Zhenyi's father supported ______ when she wanted to study the stars.
items.rule: supported 是及物动词，后接宾格 her；主格 she 只能作主语。
items.trap: 按汉语「她」直接选 she；动词后的代词一律用宾格。

items.stem: This notebook isn't mine. It's ______, because her name is on the first page.
items.rule: 名词性物主代词 hers = her + 名词，后面不能再接名词。
items.trap: 空格后没有名词就用 hers；后面有名词才用 her。

items.stem: My grandma's radio looks quite old, but ______ still works very well.
items.rule: it 作主语指代前文事物；its 是形容词性物主代词，it's = it is。
items.trap: it's 看着像所有格，其实是 it is；此处缺主语，只能选 it。

items.stem: On my father's birthday, I want to cook ______ special for the whole family.
items.rule: 肯定句用 something；形容词修饰不定代词时必须后置。
items.trap: 写成 special something 是搬汉语语序；不定代词在前，形容词在后。

items.stem: My parents are both busy, so ______ of them can take me to the museum this weekend.
items.rule: neither of + 复数代词表「两者都不」；both 表肯定，either 表任一。
items.trap: 前句 both busy，后面选 both 就逻辑矛盾；两人都不选 neither。

items.stem: Wang Zhenyi was born ______ 1768 and wrote many books about the stars.
items.rule: 年份、月份、季节前用 in；具体某天用 on，具体时刻用 at。
items.trap: 「在 1768 年」误写 on 1768；先看空后是年份还是日期。

items.stem: After breaking the vase, the little girl hid her face ______ shame.
items.rule: in + 抽象名词表状态：in shame 羞愧地，in surprise 惊讶地。
items.trap: 「羞愧地」误用 of/for；记住 in shame 是固定搭配。

items.stem: Archimedes is famous ______ finding the secret of the golden crown.
items.rule: be famous for + 原因，表「因……而闻名」；be famous as + 身份。
items.trap: for/as 混用：for 后接原因，as 后接身份。

items.stem: My sister ______ the school volunteer team, so she has no time to watch TV this week.
items.rule: be in charge of 表「负责某事」，主语是人；in the charge of 表「由……负责」。
items.trap: of 前多一个 the 意思就反过来；人负责事用 in charge of。

items.stem: ______ the moon and the stars, Wang Zhenyi studied how eclipses happen.
items.rule: in addition to + 名词/动名词 表「除……之外还」；in addition 后要逗号。
items.trap: 少写 to 成 In addition；to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

items.stem: Wang Zhenyi kept studying the stars ______ she was very interested in them.
items.rule: because 后接完整句子；because of 后接名词或动名词。
items.trap: 空后是完整句子还用 because of；先看空后是句子还是短语。

items.stem: The two geniuses' story was ______ an amazing one that everybody remembered it.
items.rule: such + a/an + 形容词 + 名词 + that；so 后直接接形容词或副词。
items.trap: 见 amazing 就选 so；后面还有名词 one，必须用 such。

items.stem: The problem was solved not by luck ______ by careful thinking.
items.rule: not A but B 表「不是 A 而是 B」，A、B 结构必须一致。
items.trap: 见 not 就选 and/or；not…but… 前后同为 by 短语，用 but。

items.stem: Either my brother or my parents ______ going to pick me up after the exam.
items.rule: either…or 连接并列主语时谓语就近一致，与 or 后最近的主语一致。
items.trap: 看到 either 就按单数选 is；看 or 后 parents 是复数，用 are。

items.stem: My mother bought two ______ and some beef for dinner tonight.
items.rule: 以 o 结尾的名词变复数多作 -es：tomato→tomatoes；photo 例外。
items.trap: 直接加 -s 写成 tomatos；two 后必须用复数 tomatoes。

items.stem: At first, the king was ______ about the crown, so he asked Archimedes to check it.
items.rule: be + 形容词 + about：doubtful 表「怀疑的」；doubt 是动词/名词。
items.trap: be 后直接放 doubt 是词性错；表语位置要形容词 doubtful。

items.stem: Linda's parents promised ______ for her fifth birthday — a doll.
items.rule: one 替代上文泛指的单数可数名词 a doll；ones 只代复数。
items.trap: 看到 a doll 就想用 it；it 指同一件已知物，这里是「一个」。

items.stem: The doll, given by 'Angel of Joy', made her the ______ child in the world.
items.rule: the + 最高级 + 名词 + in the world，表示三者以上的比较范围。
items.trap: 看到 the ___ child 就填原级；in the world 已是最高级信号。

items.stem: The never-received gift was ______ than any other gift in her eyes.
items.rule: than 是比较级标志，多音节形容词前加 more；any other 提示比较对象。
items.trap: in her eyes 诱你填最高级；有 than 就必须用 more precious。

items.stem: It was Linda's ______ birthday, and she got a gift with a card.
items.rule: 表「第几个生日」用序数词；所有格 Linda's 后直接跟 sixtieth。
items.trap: 填 sixty 变成「六十个生日」；所有格已限定，别再加 the。

items.stem: ______, they both died in a traffic accident before the doll arrived.
items.rule: 句首修饰整个句子用副词 Sadly，意为「令人难过的是」。
items.trap: 句首就想填形容词 Sad；这里修饰整句，要用副词 Sadly。

items.stem: Rita stopped before ______ store, as if drawn by something invisible.
items.rule: store 首次出现且表泛指，用不定冠词 a；an 接元音音素开头的词。
items.trap: store 以辅音音素开头，选 an 只看字母不看音；泛指不用 the。

items.stem: The robot can drive ______ itself and move cows from one field to another.
items.rule: by oneself 是固定搭配，表「独自、靠自己」。
items.trap: 中文「自己开」容易想到 with；by itself 才是「自行」。

items.stem: ______ addition to watching online tutorials, I decided to get hands-on practice.
items.rule: in addition to 是固定短语，to 后接名词或动名词。
items.trap: 按中文「另外」猜 on 或 by；把 in addition to 整块记住。

items.stem: I realized that I had to ______ on following the steps carefully.
items.rule: focus on 表「集中注意力于」，后接名词或动名词。
items.trap: follow 不能接 on；fix on、face on 也不成搭配，先验介词。

items.stem: When I first started, I would ______ up almost every cake I tried to make.
items.rule: mess up 表「弄砸」；make up 编造，take up 占用，pick up 捡起。
items.trap: 空后还有 up，别选 make；「把蛋糕做砸」是 mess up。

items.stem: Now, I am deeply ______ with the progress I have made.
items.rule: be + 过去分词 + with 表人的感受，satisfied 意为「满意的」。
items.trap: satisfying 指事物「令人满意的」；主语是 I，要用 satisfied。

items.stem: My father looked at the cake with ______ and said it looked like a pro's work.
items.rule: 介词 with 后接名词，amazement 表「惊讶」，with amazement 意为惊讶地。
items.trap: 填 amazing 是把形容词放在介词后；with 后要用名词。

items.stem: I could ______ bake a simple cookie without burning it.
items.rule: hardly 意为「几乎不」；hard 作副词是「努力地」，两词意思不同。
items.trap: 中文「很难烤好」会选 hard；could hardly 才是「几乎不能」。

items.stem: Baking a perfect cake is not an ______ or simple task.
items.rule: 与 simple 并列需形容词，ordinary 表「普通的」，符合句意。
items.trap: 与 simple 并列处要填「普通」义，其余三项都不合句意。

items.stem: When the terrorists took over her hometown, they ______ girls from attending school.
items.rule: stop sb from doing 表「阻止某人做某事」；force/allow 接 to do。
items.trap: 中文「不让女孩上学」会选 forced；force sb to do 不接 from。

items.stem: Malala's story teaches us that one voice can make a ______.
items.rule: make a difference 是固定搭配，表「起作用、带来改变」。
items.trap: make a promise 语法没错但语义不通；看「一个声音」能起什么作用。

items.stem: Her courage has ______ millions of people to fight for their dreams.
items.rule: inspire sb to do 表「激励某人做某事」，与 fight for dreams 呼应。
items.trap: amazed、interested 都不接 to do；interest 要接 in doing。

items.stem: She described her daily life under the terrorists and ______ for attention to girls' education.
items.rule: call for 表「呼吁、要求」；此处与 attention to education 搭配。
items.trap: wait for 是「等待」，pay for 是「付款」，都与「呼吁关注」无关。

items.stem: She travels all over the world, meeting leaders and ______ awareness of education.
items.rule: raise 是及物动词，「提高意识」说 raise awareness；rise 不及物。
items.trap: rise 与 raise 形近，awareness 前缺宾语时要用及物的 raising。

items.stem: Instead of giving up, she became even more ______ to fight for education rights.
items.rule: be determined to do 表「下定决心做某事」，more 修饰形容词。
items.trap: doubtful、hesitant 与 instead of giving up 相反，别选。
